The PKGBUILD defines standard metadata variables (pkgname, pkgver, etc.), dependencies, and a source URL pointing to a release binary on the official GitHub repository of the project. Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no risk of remote code execution or data exfiltration.

The checksum is provided and matches the source, but even if it were 'SKIP', that would not affect the safety of `--printsrcinfo`. No obfuscated code or suspicious constructs are present.
</details>
